{{Top}}
'''Corell Industries Limited''', also called '''CI Limited''' or just '''CI''', was a a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] shipping concern that ferried goods to worlds within the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and to [[Centerpoint Station]].

For a time, CI was one of the top investment opportunities in the Corellian system. But in part because of actions taken by the monopolistic [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], which was devouring small shipping concerns one after the other, CI's fortunes began to decline, and inaction from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] failed to provide any help. The company's profits began sliding and CI was forced to sell off its fleet of ships at ridiculously low prices, before ultimately succumbing to bankruptcy.
